SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES

_________________

No. 23–370

_________________

PAUL ERLINGER, PETITIONER v. UNITED STATES

on writ of certiorari to the united states court of appeals for the seventh circuit

[June 21, 2024]

Chief Justice Roberts, concurring.

I join the opinion of the Court because I agree that under the Fifth and Sixth Amendments, a defendant is entitled to have a jury determine beyond a reasonable doubt whether his predicate offenses were committed on different occasions for purposes of the Armed Career Criminal Act. But as Justice Kavanaugh explains, violations of that right are subject to harmless error review. See post, at 9–11 (dissenting opinion). The Seventh Circuit should thus consider on remand the Government’s contention that the error here was harmless.
